title: Amend ADR 0028 to name the TPM2 blob directory (DEC-262 a22 condition 3)
description: DEC-262 (a22) Q-B: the blob directory is <wardDir>/tpm/<vaultId>/, mode 0700 via preparePrivateDirectory; a pre-existing directory not user-owned or not 0700 refuses blob_not_user_private and is never chmodded. Amend ADR 0028 stored-format clause to name the directory; a later move is a vault-format change that goes to opum-doc first. Small docs PR, separate from slice 3d; build after 3d-1a lands. See WCLI-21.
